component.name: Steward
component.summary: Manage every installed application in one place

description.p: Steward lists all installed applications, whether they came from apt, Flatpak, Snap, an AppImage or a hand-made launcher, and shows where each desktop entry lives.

ul.li: Launch, update or uninstall any application
Edit names, icons, keywords and categories of menu entries in place
Find and clean up broken menu entries
